subject: Request: Executive approval for >20% hosted API rebate (Lumina Health)
messages:
From: Kara Jacobs <kara.jacobs@luminahealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Evan Liu <evan.liu@luminahealth.com>, procurement@luminahealth.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing request + SOW

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We scoped the internal ask and Lumina wants to move forward with a 24-month commitment across three regions (US, EU, APAC). Estimated monthly tokens start small but ramp heavily in Q4.

Two asks before procurement will sign: 1) a 24% unit-price rebate off list for the committed usage tier; 2) a shortened payment term (Net 30) and an acceptance SLT in the SOW for latency under 250ms 95th percentile in US region.

I attached the updated SOW and our usage forecast. Can you confirm whether Redwood can approve a 24% discount and the shortened payment term? If not, what would be the minimum concession to keep Lumina on an accelerated timeline?

Appreciate a quick reply — procurement is asking to close by end of month.

Kara

[Attachment: Lumina_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: usage_forecast_Q3-Q4.xlsx (XLSX, 85KB)]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing request + SOW

Marissa / Ben —

Forwarding Lumina's ask. Short summary: 24% off list for a 24-month, multi-region commit + Net 30 and a US latency acceptance clause. Lumina is strategic (large payer-integrated partner) and reasonable retention upside if we can meet the price and SLO.

Why I’m escalating: our standard threshold for senior approval is >20%. This is a 24% request and also includes Net 30 (we typically ask Net 45 for first-year enterprise pilots) and a tighter latency SLA.

Key deal economics (from forecast):
- Expected starting monthly spend: ~$120k (month 1) ramping to $1.1M/mo by month 15
- Committed minimum ARR for year 1 (pro forma): ~$6.5M
- Proposed discount reduces unit revenue by ~24% across committed tiers

Attachments: redlined MSA is also attached (they requested a carve-out for data residency in APAC).

Request: Marissa — can you approve a 24% concession for this strategic onramp if we get a signed 24-month commitment and a DocuSign-ready SOW by 6/30? Ben — any immediate billing/legal flags with Net 30 + acceptance SLA?

I recommend approving with two conditions: 1) Finance signs off on Net 30 if Lumina provides a purchase order and pre-authorized charge agreement; 2) we hold an operational readiness call with Infra SRE to confirm latency commitments before DocuSign.

Thanks,
Karthik

[Attachment: redlined_master_sub_agreement.docx (DOCX, 210KB)]

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing request + SOW

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear summary. I’m supportive of a concession above 20% for strategic retention plays when economics justify it. Lumina’s ramp profile and cross-region footprint make this a high-opportunity account. I will approve a maximum of 24% off list under the following guardrails: 

1) 24-month minimum committed term with quarterly minimum consumption floors in the SOW (to protect GTM churn).
2) Upfront security attestation (SOC 2 Type II report) and APAC data residency plan included in the SOW.
3) Finance-signed PO or an initial prepayment covering month 1 (Ben to confirm whether prepay or PO is required for Net 30).
4) Limit long-term precedent: this approval requires us to flag the concession in Deal Desk and include a 3-year precedent review.

Ben — please confirm finance OK on the Net 30 + acceptance SLA if they provide PO + initial prepay or else propose the minimum alternative (Net 45 with partial prepay).

If you (Karthik) get procurement to agree to the quarterly floors and PO/prepay, consider this approved from strategy side. Please loop in SRE and Security for the SLO/attestation.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Strategy | Redwood Inference
[signature]

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing request + SOW

Quick finance read: Net 30 is doable but only with a PO + initial prepayment equal to month 1 usage or an approved credit check. For this level of concession (24%) I want the following on record before signing: 

- PO uploaded to billing portal and an initial auto-charge of month 1 once SOW signs (we can accept ACH or card).
- Quarterly minimums (as Marissa suggested) with automated true-up billing so we don't carry downside risk.
- The SOW must call out invoicing cadence and the acceptance SLA language must be operationalized (we will require an SRE confirmation email as part of contract handoff).

If Karthik can secure the PO + prepay and the quarterly floors, finance will clear Net 30 and I will stamp the approval. Otherwise fallback to Net 45 + 50% prepay.

Ben

[Attachment: billing_terms_template.pdf (PDF, 65KB)]
